industry.summary: This week marked two major milestones for Starlink Mobile. SpaceX announced an agreement to acquire a nationwide low-band spectrum license portfolio of up to 14 megahertz of paired spectrum in the 800 MHz band. This prime low-band spectrum addresses one of the key remaining technical gaps that will pave the way for Starlink Mobile to become a major mobile carrier in the US.

papers.title: A Neural Implicit Flow Super-Resolution Approach for Reacting Flows
papers.summary: We present a novel framework for reconstructing fine-resolution scalar fields from coarse-resolution data in 2D unsteady flames using an extension of neural implicit flow (NIF). The framework leverages the novel architecture of NIF to develop an efficient representation of scalar fields in spatio-temporal reacting flows.

papers.title: The Effect of Acoustic Noise on Aero-Optical Measurements in Wind Tunnels
papers.summary: Both ground and flight test data show that optical wavefront measurements can detect and be influenced by acoustic noise, where the optical aberrations originate from density variations associated with the sound waves. This finding has implications regarding the potential effect of background acoustic noise on optical measurements during wind-tunnel testing.
